title: 第7章 种植区的第一棵水果树
novel_title: 我在星际召唤古人，带飞华夏文明
content_zh:
翌日，花期浑身酸痛地起床。

    昨天干活太累，一晚上睡死过去，导致个人终端的闹铃响了她都起不来。

    这也让她错过了小助说的星网羊毛，今早没早饭吃了。

    花期点开个人终端看了眼，账户余额还剩下不到四百块，再不赚点钱很快都要吃土，也不知道古城猴年马月才能开张。

    她轻叹一口气，早知道被赶出门那会儿就该多带点首饰，这样也能拿去换钱。

    她不知道自己当时是脑子抽了还是怎么回事。

    花家给的所有东西都不要，硬是净身出户，现在想起来就想给她一耳光。

    什么叫见识到社会的厉害？

    上下两辈子，花期算是见识到社会的厉害了。

    肚子饿得不行，她到处翻了翻，翻出一包昨天凑单送的泡面。

    花期简单把泡面煮了，自己抱着锅吃了一半，另一半装进外卖盒子准备给荣华送过去。

    她戴好帽子和冰冰贴，换了另一件九块九秒杀的防晒长裙，端起早饭前往种植区。

    荣华十分钟前便到了，有了她昨天的嘱咐，这会儿正在地里干活。

    不过花期一走进种植区，没有第一时间看到荣华的身影，而是被一棵树给吸引了。

    她站在种植区门口，惊骇地望着地上突然长出来的一棵树。

    树干有她腰身粗，树冠宽阔呈圆头形，树荫舒展，一串串手掌大小的黄色果实挂在树上。

    这...

    这是芒果树？

    哪里来的芒果树？

    “小助，什么情况？种植区不是黑土地啊？”

    【城主，这是俺们古城特色，种植区和花圃的特色便是植物会很快生长。昨天您不是扔了几颗种子在地里，芒果树经过一晚上生长，在今早开花结果，预期还要半小时才会到达最佳食用时机】

    “还能这样！”

    花期的震撼迅速被欣喜替代。

    这不就是游戏中说的催熟神器，土壤特殊，种下去的植物也会变得神奇。

    有些一夜之间成熟，有些一夜之间变异，往往味道都很不错。

    她双眼亮晶晶地望着一树水果，火速想到一个发财的办法了。

    蓝白星之所以能成为旅游大热星球，和这边的饮食文化有很大关系。

    经常看星际小说的人都知道，星际饮食匮乏，很少有星球种出食物。
content_en:
The next day, Hua Shi got up with soreness all over.

    She was too tired from work yesterday and fell asleep all night, causing her to be unable to get up when the alarm on her personal terminal rang.

    This also made her miss the Starnet Wool that Xiaosuke mentioned, and she didn't have breakfast this morning.

    Hua Qi opened the personal terminal and took a look. There was less than 400 yuan left in his account. If he didn't make some money, he would soon be in ruins. He didn't know that the ancient city would only open in the Year of the Monkey and the Horse.

    She sighed softly. If she had known she would be kicked out of the house, she should have brought more jewelry so that she could exchange it for money.

    She didn't know if she had a brain twitch or something.

    She didn't want anything given by the Hua family and just left the house. Now that she thinks about it, she wants to slap her in the face.

    What does it mean to see the power of society?

    In two lifetimes, Hua Qi has seen the power of society.

    Feeling extremely hungry, she rummaged around and found a pack of instant noodles that she had ordered yesterday.

    Hua Qi simply cooked the instant noodles, ate half of them while holding the pot, and put the other half into a takeout box to send to Rong Hua.

    She put on her hat and ice cream, changed into another sun-proof dress that was sold for nine yuan and nine seconds, picked up her breakfast and headed to the planting area.

    Ronghua arrived ten minutes ago. Following her instructions yesterday, she is currently working in the fields.

    However, as soon as I walked into the planting area during the flower season, I didn't see Ronghua's figure immediately, but was attracted by a tree.

    She stood at the door of the planting area, looking in horror at a tree that suddenly grew out of the ground.

    The trunk is as thick as her waist, the crown is broad and round-headed, the shade is extended, and bunches of yellow fruits the size of a palm hang on the tree.

    This...

    Is this a mango tree?

    Where did the mango tree come from?

    "Xiaosuke, what's going on? The planting area is not black soil?"

    [City Lord, this is a characteristic of our ancient city. The characteristic of the planting area and flower garden is that plants grow quickly. Didn't you throw a few seeds into the ground yesterday? The mango tree grew overnight and blossomed and bore fruit this morning. It is expected that it will take another half an hour to reach the best time for consumption]

    "It can still be like this!"

    The shock of flowering was quickly replaced by joy.

    Isn't this the ripening artifact mentioned in the game? The soil is special and the plants planted will become magical.

    Some ripen overnight, some mutate overnight, and they often taste good.

    She looked at a tree of fruits with bright eyes and quickly thought of a way to make a fortune.

    The reason why Blue and White Star has become a popular tourist destination has a lot to do with its food culture.

    Anyone who often reads interstellar novels knows that interstellar food is scarce, and few planets grow food.
title_en: Chapter 7 The first fruit tree in the planting area
